description: Use to monitor what a specific Bluesky account has posted recently: returns up to 50 posts (original posts by default, optionally including replies/reposts) with text, time, likes/reposts/replies, outbound links and URLs. Cursor pagination supported. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
